description: Two enforcement points, per DESIGN.md 4.1. SessionStart verifies every skill, agent definition and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md under the project and ~/.claude, reporting failures into session context. PreToolUse(Skill) re-verifies the skill bundle at invocation time and blocks execution on a signature failure. The module (register.ts, Claude Code mods) gates what the model reads before it reads it: every skill expansion, each CLAUDE.md behind the first message, and each user-installed plugin that ships a hooks module before that module loads. Fail-open by default (the ecosystem is mostly unsigned); PROMPTSIGN_STRICT=1, or strict: true in the user or managed policy, makes them fail closed. With PROMPTSIGN_AUTO_SIGN=1, PostToolUse(Write|Edit) signs the skill Claude wrote as the signed-in user, and SessionStart re-signs the user's own changed skills (scripts/autosign.mjs).
